joy_pancakes.title: Pancakes Recipe
ingredients: extra melted butter for greasing the pan
steps: In a large bowl whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.
In a separate bowl whisk together the egg, milk, and melted butter.
Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and then pour in the egg mixture, all at once, and stir (with a rubber spatula or wooden spoon) just until combined.
Heat a frying pan or griddle over medium high heat until a few sprinkles of water dropped on the pan or griddle splatter.
Adjust the temperature as needed.
Using a piece of paper towel or a pastry brush, lightly brush the pan with melted butter or oil (or spray with a non stick vegetable spray.)
Using a small ladle or scoop, pour about 1/4 cup (60 ml) of pancake batter onto the hot pan, spacing the pancakes a few inches apart.
When the bottoms of the pancakes are brown and bubbles start to appear on the top surfaces of the pancakes (2-3 minutes), turn over.
Cook until lightly browned (about 1-2 minutes).
Repeat with remaining batter, brushing the pan with melted butter or oil between batches.
Serve immediately with butter and maple syrup.

cfe_banana.title: Banana Nut Bread
steps: Butter and flour a loaf pan
Preheat oven to 350°F (170°C)
Mash the bananas, butter and vanilla until smooth
Lightly beat the eggs
Whisk the flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt and sugar
Fold in the walnuts
Bake 350°F (170°C) 55 min.
Cool 10 min. in pan
Cool on wire rack

infographic_pancakes.title: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
In a jug, whisk the buttermilk, eggs, melted butter and vanilla.
Pour the wet mix into the dry and stir until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes while a non-stick pan heats over medium heat.
Pour ¼ cup (60 ml) batter per pancake and cook 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles form.
Flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more until golden. Serve warm with maple syrup.
